reason: In the patched GroupsController#add_members, `params.require(:usernames)` is followed by `usernames.split(",")` with no type check. With `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b`, ActiveSupport's Array#split returns `[["a","b"]]`, so it is `User.find_by_username` (app/models/user.rb:176, `username.downcase`) that raises NoMethodError, not split itself; the request still ends in a 500.
